scope: Switch Lite GM20B, Windows ARM64, two native KMD builds with identical graphics, power and decode components. Only the production worker object changed.

code.candidate_branch_role: Frozen source of the promoted physical driver.

method.scheduler: Microsoft-Windows-DxgKrnl. Match QueuePacket starts (178 for DMA, 244/245 for fence synchronization) to event 180 by hContext, submit sequence and queue-packet identity before reuse. Match DmaPacket 175 and 176 in that interval using the context and queue sequence. DMA wall time includes driver polling, interrupts and OS scheduling. It is not an engine timestamp.
method.workload: For each kernel and each user-mode ABI, two independent warm 32 x 32 Vulkan triangle processes, 24 serial submissions each. All 1,024 pixels plus both 64-byte guards were checked per submission. An initial one-draw process populated the six shader cache entries. Each measured process reported six hits and zero misses.
method.residency: Ordinary CPU-visible allocations of 4 and 16 MiB per ABI through the existing KMT memory probe. The CPU-side MakeResident ETW entry and return are paired by PID/TID. STATUS_PENDING requires the backend paging-fence wait. The API interval alone does not time GPU residency completion. Group counters and allocation outcomes are recorded separately.
method.controls: The driver change requires a reboot. The same application ICDs, desktop UMD, native KMD feature set, CPU/GPU/EMC Handheld policy and AC power were used. Frequencies are instantaneous samples with the normal governor active. Battery voltage is not system wattage. Reported percentiles use nearest rank.
method.reference_trace_close: Six completed memory probes and six pixel-checked Vulkan probes were durably recorded. The reference controller exited while closing its trace. The host explicitly stopped the same ETW session on the same boot and DWM, checked its absence and hashed the closed file. Only the fixture interval was analyzed.
